description: feat/permanent-wounds: the CONTROL for EV-027 — a wound-only drawback (Maimed Hand, 2 AP) that is NOT DM-imposed: a player-style purchase paying +2 AP income. Players never see wound-only entries in a picker, so this can only be hand-edited or built without the imposition marker, and it must raise the hard warning '⛔ Maimed Hand: a wound — only a DM can impose it'. Without this control EV-027's empty warning list could mean the wound-only check is simply broken.
